mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have lovely clear skies with a temperature of 80 degrees near Verona City Hall under a waning crescent moon.

The city is highlighting several programs today, including the tri-shaw bike service at the senior center and the ongoing rain barrel rebate policy to help manage stormwater. Additionally, the recreation department is looking for new team members.

There is so much happening in our area. Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Baileys Run, Paddys Macs, and Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, do not miss the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena.
In a noteworthy call from July 28, an officer located an occupied vehicle in Firemans Park after closing hours, which resulted in a man being taken into custody on an outstanding arrest warrant.
Today is a great day to enjoy an Andes Mint Avalanche at Culvers, which is open until 10:30 PM. You can also catch the Kona Ice truck at Firemans Park today until 4 PM.
